title: SharedClassificationResult
description: Canonical API contract shared across React frontend, FastAPI ONNX inference backend, and Supabase persistence layer.

classification_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this classification event.

predicted_class.description: Top predicted taxonomy class name, or null if rejected or unresolved.

candidate_predictions.description: Ordered candidate predictions from the ONNX model. Scores are model outputs, not classification accuracy.

model_version.description: Explicit identifier of the ONNX model artifact and preprocessing configuration.

decision_status.description: Outcome from the deterministic policy and category-to-bin decision engine.

recommended_bin.description: Configured segregation bin identifier only when decision_status is accepted and mapping is verified; otherwise null.

requires_manual_review.description: True whenever confidence is below threshold, mapping is unverified/missing, or input requires operator verification.

review_reason.description: Explicit rationale when manual review is required or input was rejected.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of classification event creation.
